name: Jojoba oil
description: Jojoba oil (CAS 61789-91-1 ), also marketed as jojoba bean oil, is a liquid wax ester extracted from the seeds of Simmondsia chinensis. Unlike conventional triglyceride oils, it functions as a long-chain wax. This unique structure delivers exceptional oxidative stability and lubrication across personal care and industrial applications. In cosmetics, it acts as a skin-conditioning base and emollient in moisturizers and serums. Its compatibility with sebum supports consistent formulation performance in hair oils and lip products. Industrial lubricant formulators use it as a high-pressure lubricant and metal cutting fluid additive. It is particularly valued where biodegradability is a procurement requirement. In coatings and adhesives, it functions as a plasticizing agent and dispersant to improve flexibility and substrate adhesion. Sealant and elastomer manufacturers incorporate it to extend workability and reduce brittleness in finished compounds. The oil is supplied as a clear to slightly golden liquid with various grades available. Refined and unrefined grades meet different formulation requirements. Refined grades are standard for cosmetic applications, while cold-pressed material is available for natural and organic product lines. It is commonly offered in drums and IBC totes for bulk industrial use. Cosmetic-grade material conforms to specifications recognized by major pharmacopeial and industry standards like USP and BP . The material also meets requirements for EP and Ph.Eur. standards where applicable. This ensures high purity and consistency for global manufacturers across the personal care and chemical sectors.
